item.title: Xi’s Apec summit speech is a call to cooperation suited to the times
item.description: In his keynote speech at the Apec CEO Summit in Shenzhen on November 18, President Xi Jinping quoted the ancient Chinese saying “fan yi zhi dao yu shi jie xing”, which suggests that all approaches must move with the times to be of benefit. item.title: How the battle to host UN high seas treaty tests China’s push for global leadership
item.description: A rival joint bid by Belgium and Chile to host the secretariat for the landmark UN high seas treaty could present a fresh diplomatic test for Beijing ahead of the 2027 vote. Observers say the surprise November 6 announcement of their merged bid to oversee the Agreement on Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ) will complicate China’s efforts to secure its first major UN body headquarters. item.title: Paolo Bulgari, the Italian jeweller who dazzled stars and supermodels, dies at 89
item.description: Paolo Bulgari, the grandson of a Greek silversmith who helped transform the family jewellery business into a global luxury brand synonymous with Italian glamour and design, has died. He was 89. His family announced his death on Saturday, describing him as “the greatest jeweller of our time” and praising his humanity and entrepreneurial talent.
